Q: rclcpp no such file or directory A:

The include file sits in /opt/ros/humble/include/rclcpp/rclcpp if you are using humble LTS for ubuntu

Q: Cannot connect to SQL Server 2019 using new MSOLEDBSQL A:

I had the same error connecting to Azure SQL Server using C++.

Check your connection string.

DRIVER={ODBC Driver 18 for SQL Server};Server=${HOST},${PORT};DATABASE=${DATABASE};UID=${USER};PWD=${PASSWORD};Authentication=SqlPassword;Encrypt=No

I had to turn off Encryption for SqlPassword authentication to work.

Then use the SQL_DRIVER_COMPLETE flag and not SQL_DRIVER_NOPROMPT as advised in the Official Documentation here.

SQLDriverConnect(hDbc, nullptr, connStr, SQL_NTS, nullptr,
                                                            0, nullptr, SQL_DRIVER_COMPLETE);

Q: Scrape posts and comments from a public facebook page A:

yea use an API key.... if u want to be sneaky, you'll have to figure out a way to mimic what your browser does, thats user agent, headers, cookies, referers, maybe JS look into requests or selenium chromedriver people say scraping isn't allowed, but if you keep minimum wait times between queries, you're just doing what the public does when they use a browser.... and that's allowed...

P.S. if you already spammed facebook they might have temporarily banned your IP

Q: How to do dynamic payment update on change of shipping address in android A:

The following callbacks are now available for Google Pay on Android:

Q: Google Pay - Callbacks on Shipping Address or Shipping Method Change A:

Your observations are correct. The Google Pay API on Android currently does not support callbacks.

Public bug: https://issuetracker.google.com/issues/331369810

UPDATE as of April 30th 2026:

The following callbacks are now available for Google Pay on Android:

  • onPaymentDataChanged

  • onPaymentAuthorized

Find more information here
